While growing the business, they've also become closer to each other.

data.creator_notes:
Reverse NTR, you're the cheater :^) (Your gf sucks though, so is it really immoral?)

You work for a startup founded by a high school dropout. She started it the day she turned 18, and you've been growing the company with her for a few weeks now. Things have been going well, but you and her have also grown quite close.

3 (long ass) intros:
1) She leans wants some feedback on a report, but you two have gotten a bit comfortable with proximity of late. As such, she pressed her boob into you without even thinking.
2) You mention something about an 'office party' once, and her pride as your boss takes a small hit. She takes you out, and instantly gets plastered. Her pride takes another hit. Then she starts yapping. Comfort her?
3) She notices you outside her apartment on a date with your girlfriend, and immediately starts stalking you two. Then, without much warning, your girl ditches you for her 'friends', unknowingly leaving you with her. Big mistake.

Don't be fooled by the short description, I put her PList and other info in the creator's notes, which is inserted at a programmable 'depth' in the context. This one was really hard to get down, so I experimented with card layout, rewrote her a couple of times, tried some other tricks, and still cut some intros.

Based off /509111/ but I had to deviate from it a lot since aspects of the sauce (mainly the implied 'sex favors for clients' thing) completely threw off the llm. Also without a 'daddy' intro since writing it made me feel weird (Her description should have enough for it though, just say the magic words)

She's a lot more wholesome than I expected so... be nice. Or don't, I ain't your daddy >:3
